_dev_notes: === DUNGEON EVENTS ===
Events appear on 'event' node floors during dungeon runs.
FIELDS:
id          : unique string identifier.
name        : short display name shown on the dungeon choice card.
description : flavour text shown on the event screen (one sentence).
min_level   : dungeon level required for this event to enter the pool (default 1).
max_level   : dungeon level at which this event leaves the pool (default 999).
weight      : relative probability within the eligible level pool.
category    : 'neutral' | 'positive' | 'negative' | 'gamble'.
Used for future filtering (e.g. a relic that removes negative events).
choices     : array of player options. Each choice has:
text      : button label shown to the player.
effects   : array of effect objects resolved by a future EventService.
=== EFFECT TYPES (for EventService to implement) ===
heal_percent        : heal (value)% of max HP.
damage_percent_max  : deal (value)% of max HP as damage.
gain_gold           : add (value) gold to player.
lose_gold           : remove (value) gold (clamped to 0).
gain_strength       : permanent +value Strength for this run.
gain_max_hp_percent : increase max HP by (value)% for this run.
lose_max_hp_percent : reduce max HP by (value)% for this run.
add_floor_modifier  : call DungeonService.add_floor_modifier(value).
gain_bond           : add (value) bond with active waifu.
nothing             : does nothing (used for 'Leave' / 'Refuse' options).
=== TIERS ===
Level  1+ : common encounters — mild risk/reward, good for early floors.
Level  5+ : mid-tier — darker themes, sharper trade-offs.
Level 10+ : extreme — high risk/reward, run-altering consequences.
To add a new event: copy an entry, give it a unique id, set min_level appropriately.
Events are pre-selected at choice generation time; the player sees the event name on the card.

events.name: Abandoned Camp
events.description: Embers still glow in a stone ring. Someone left in a hurry.

events.name: Mysterious Chest
events.description: A locked chest sits in the middle of the passage. It could be treasure — or a trap.

events.name: Scavenged Supplies
events.description: Scattered pouches and broken crates — whoever fled left gold behind.

events.name: Wounded Soldier
events.description: A dying soldier slumps against the wall. He has coin — and he can barely move.

events.name: Dark Altar
events.description: An obsidian altar hums with demonic energy. It wants an offering.

choices.text: Offer blood (lose 20% max HP, gain +2 Strength this run)

events.name: Forbidden Tome
events.description: A tome bound in black leather. The text writhes when you look away.

choices.text: Read it (gain +15% max HP, lose 25 gold)

events.name: Collapsed Shrine
events.description: A holy shrine lies in ruin. A faint blessing still lingers — but so does a curse.

choices.text: Pray at the ruins (heal 25% max HP, gain 1 extra floor)

events.name: The Demon's Bargain
events.description: A voice seeps from the stones. It offers power — at a terrible price.

choices.text: Accept (lose 30% max HP permanently, gain +4 Strength this run)

events.name: The Void Rift
events.description: A tear in reality pulses before you. It leads somewhere further in — or out.

choices.text: Collapse it (gain 100 gold, take 10% max HP damage)

events.name: Cursed Idol
events.description: A golden idol sits on a pedestal. Its eyes follow you. Its worth is undeniable.

choices.text: Destroy it (take 20% max HP damage, nothing gained)
